author: harrier_studio
title: Harrier Studio hiring illustrators and comic artists
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! Open positions: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Send CV and portfolio to harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subject: Name – Position – CV & Portfolio). Open until positions are filled.

title: Call for illustrator for MOZAIK 44
content: CALL FOR ILLUSTRATOR — MOZAIK 44. Looking for an illustrator to bring the next edition of MOZAIK to life. Send CV, motivation letter and portfolio. Deadline: 30 September 2026. Email: wscf@wscf-europe.org
